protocol.session_isolation: independent subprocess per cell; fresh TRITON_CACHE_DIR per session
protocol.cold: first call in a fresh process (one-shot: plan + compile included)
protocol.warm: raw trials after warmup=5 rounds=5 trials=32 (plan-reuse steady state)
protocol.bootstrap: B=2000 paired resample of warm trial arrays, seed=102026, percentile 95% CI
protocol.promotion_gate: cell enters selector only if bootstrap CI lower bound of speedup > 1.02 in EVERY session, vs vendor AND incumbent
protocol.incumbent_join_caveat: issue9 v61 e2e protocol differs from this holdout (different warmup/rounds machinery, its own plan-reuse definition); join is same-shape/axis/dtype (fp32, last-axis c2c) magnitude comparison only, not a like-for-like timing protocol. hybrid cold 口径 compared against incumbent:one_shot where present.
